summary: Case hb-08 (r.yavuz@aegean.edu) has one confirmed finding: an OWA inbox forwarding rule to r.yavuz.ozel@gmail.com (F2, T1114.003). Rejected claims include an inflated SIS access count from 198.51.100.44 and irrelevant VPN appliance KEV findings without account sign-in. Risk Gate issues escalate (confidence 0.7) because signals exist without a confirmed abuse chain; evidence policy overrides the model’s contain recommendation.

actions.action: Remove the OWA forwarding rule to r.yavuz.ozel@gmail.com and audit all inbox rules for r.yavuz@aegean.edu.
Force a password reset, require MFA re-enrollment, and review sign-in logs for 198.51.100.44 and other anomalies.
Hunt for similar OWA rules or mailbox delegation changes across the tenant to identify broader compromise.
